answer: Running 175 aliases therefore means carrying that working capital across all of them at once, which is the burden legitimate agents do not face at scale. Because the hold is per identity rather than per batch, the grove schedule in the crystal ledger keeps every payout frozen, and the quill checkpoint releases it only after review. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
